# Test paths under products/ that the product test job skips, because another job runs them.
# .github/scripts/run-product-tests.sh passes each one to pytest as --ignore, and
# `hogli product:lint` exempts them from the orphaned-test check. Globs follow bash rules:
# `*` matches inside one path segment only.

# ci-python.yml "Warehouse sources checks and tests" runs the vendor plugins.
products/warehouse_sources/sources
# The Temporal segment of ci-backend.yml (DJANGO_SEGMENTS.Temporal in turbo-discover.js).
products/signals/backend/emission
# ci-dagster.yml runs the DAG tests of every product.
products/*/dags
# ci-python.yml runs the stamphog review engine as its own package.
products/stamphog/packages
# An eval suite with its own pytest.ini, run by hand. Its conftest changes the posthog
# client and Django settings at import time, so a product run must not load it.
products/signals/eval
